snippet.title: Flowers And Favours ❘ Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
🌸 Flowers And Favours is OUT NOW!!! 🌼

💐 Make beautiful bouquets
🐰 Meet adorable customers
💕 Made solo with loooots of love

This is my debut game, and I'm so proud of how it turned out! Thank you so much for your support and for appreciating my little game 🥰

Play Flowers And Favours on Steam: https://s.team/a/3269600
